claims.claim_en: The particle 'مَنْ' here is an interrogative (استفهام) occupying the position of a mubtada' (subject).
'يُضْلِلْ' (the verb) functions as the khabar (predicate) of the clause introduced by 'مَنْ'.

claims.claim_ar: موضع الجملة (جملة «مَنْ يُضِلُّ ...») منصوب لوجود فعل مقدر «يَعْلَمُ».
claims.claim_en: The position of the sentence (the clause with 'مَنْ ... يُضِلُّ') is to be considered in the accusative because of an implied verb 'يَعْلَمُ' (i.e., an elided verb is understood).

claims.claim_ar: المؤلف يستشهد بمثلٍ لذلك (الكهف: ١٢) لتوضيح نفس بنية استفهام «مَنْ» وموقعها كابتداء، أي أن هذه البنية لها أمثلة أخرى في القرآن.
claims.claim_en: The author cites a comparable example (al-Kahf:12) to illustrate the same interrogative 'مَنْ' structure functioning as a subject; this shows the construction has parallels elsewhere in the Qur'an.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited example is given as support; applicability to the exact syntactic scope in this verse is inferred rather than demonstrated step-by-step in the excerpt.
